a: The AKPRO Archive is a centralized digital repository maintained by IME FTUI. It hosts historical academic data, study guides, and verified course materials to support students throughout their degree.

q: How do I access specific course materials?
a: You can use the 'Resource Index' above or the search bar in the hero section. Materials are organized by curriculum type (Transition, Academic, and Media) for streamlined navigation.

q: Can I contribute my own study notes?
a: Yes! We encourage knowledge sharing. You can submit your verified notes or exam solutions through the AKPRO BPHSA team for review and inclusion in the archive.
Tutorials and 'Asistensi' sessions are managed by the Academic and Professional Department. Schedules are updated weekly in the Tutorial Index section of this portal.

q: How often is the database updated?
a: The database undergoes major updates at the start of every semester, with smaller updates occurring weekly as new materials and tutorial recordings become available.
